summary: CoinShares PLC furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release for its FY2025 annual results, an investor presentation, and a CEO letter. The filing reports financial metrics including revenue of $165.7M, net income of $114.3M, and gross AUM of $7.4B. It notes the completion of a business combination with Vine Hill Capital Investment Corp. and a Nasdaq listing on April 1, 2026, but this prior transaction is not the subject of the current filing. As a routine earnings release, this is not a special-situation event; no deal terms or premium are provided.
